home.eyebrow: Cuban flavors in the heart of Moscow
home.title: Authentic Cuban cuisine, at your door.
home.intro: We bring Cuba's culinary traditions to Moscow. Family recipes, fresh ingredients, and Caribbean flavors that transport you to Havana.
home.featuredEyebrow: From our kitchen to your table
home.featuredError: We can't load the featured dishes right now.
home.noFeatured: We're preparing the menu. Come back soon to discover our dishes.
home.valueCookingText: We prepare every order with care and attention, just like at home.
home.valueCareText: Authentic Cuban flavors, cooked in Moscow with grandma's recipes.
home.valueDeliveryText: Order online and enjoy Cuban cuisine without leaving home.
home.aboutTitle: A piece of Cuba in Moscow
home.aboutText: We were born from the dream of sharing my grandmother's kitchen with Moscow. I'm Adrian, a Cuban chef, and every dish carries the taste of my homeland: ropa vieja, roast pork, moros y cristianos, yuca with mojo... We cook with heart, as if you were family.
home.aboutPointOne: Authentic Cuban recipes, no adaptations or shortcuts.
home.aboutPointTwo: Fresh ingredients and spices brought directly from Cuba.
home.howTitle: Your Cuban taste in three steps
home.stepOneText: Browse the menu and find your favorite Cuban flavors.
home.stepTwoText: Add your favorites to the cart and confirm your order.
home.stepThreeText: We'll get cooking so you can enjoy at home like in Havana.
home.visitText: Browse the menu and place your order online. We deliver across Moscow.
